==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Tykwer:''' What took her so long...
:{{DIcon}} Are you waiting for someone?
:'''Tykwer:''' Oh yes. I'm waiting for [[Camellya]]—the Bloom Bearer covered in vines.
:{{DIcon}} What does she do here?
:'''Tykwer:''' She usually handles the "germination test." It's the test we give to new candidates.
:'''Tykwer:''' The Gardeners organize their personal info, and the [[Tethys System]] decides how they'll be evaluated.
:'''Tykwer:''' I've heard Camellya takes care of all the combat-oriented tests. She always grabs the candidates' profiles without notifying us and does her thing.
:'''Tykwer:''' By the time we find her, the test is already over, and she just smacks the results in our faces.
:{{DIcon}} That sounds efficient.
:'''Tykwer:''' Not exactly. She's gotten a lot of complaints... Honestly, I don't know how to talk to her about it. It's just too awkward...
:{{DIcon}} What do the complaints say?
:'''Tykwer:''' Mostly that she's more interested in fighting that actually running the tests...
:{{DIcon}} Of course she is.
:'''Tykwer:''' Her methods can be a bit intense, but they're great for pressure tests or for vetting candidates in dangerous regions.
:'''Tykwer:''' If you can pass her test, it means you've got the physical and mental strength to handle extreme situations.
:'''Tykwer:''' Overall, she's a solid tester. I just wish I didn't have to clean up the mess she leaves behind...
{{Dialogue End}}
